$comment: aximprint pipeline harness config (tracked, shared). Imported from the axRange framework 2026-08-03. The permission allowlist lets background workers run reads/tests/preflight unattended; the gates are aximprint's, not axRange's — there is no cluster here, so what stays gated is (a) anything that MOVES real capture data onto this host or derives a large artifact from it — rationale restated 2026-08-12, when forensic completeness superseded the Privacy rule (CHANGELOG 2026-08-12, CONVENTIONS §3): the reason is now cost and blast radius (a live production appliance, multi-GB transfers, disk), NOT disclosure, and merely READING a local capture or a store derived from one is not gated here and never was (cat/head/ls are allowlisted below); the permission lists were deliberately left unchanged by that ratification, (b) git commit/push/tag, (c) dependency installs (the project is deliberately thin: duckdb + pyyaml, plus requests in the optional acquire extra), (d) any axrange CLI call, which mutates a shared cluster and belongs to the sibling project's own gates, and (e) since the 2026-08-10 xtract merge (docs/WORK_ORDER_merge_xtract_acquire.md step 8), `aximprint acquire pcap`/`aximprint acquire harvest` and `podman` — pcap/harvest reach a live production appliance and pull real capture data onto this host, the same class of risk as (a) and (d) together, so they must never run unattended; `aximprint acquire streams` is read-only catalog reporting (no disk write, no podman) and is deliberately NOT listed here, same tier as `status`. Note there is deliberately NO schema gate: aximprint's schemas are incubating and change freely (DESIGN_BRIEF §0.2, CONVENTIONS §1.2) — the axRange 'version-locked schema' rule is suspended here, and RATIFYING a schema to v1 is what needs the user, not editing one. Hooks are NOT here: v5 moved the pipeline MECHANISM host-global (~/.claude/settings.json links them into the template clone) and left POLICY per-repo, which is this file plus .claude-workflow.env, .claude-doc-stats.json, docs/LESSONS.md and scripts/verify_pipeline_gates.sh. A hooks block here would register every hook TWICE — that was the pre-migration state and it fired every Stop hook twice. The global hooks resolve the project at runtime and no-op in any repo that never onboarded.
